description: Visualize C#, Python, JavaScript, VisuAlg and Portugol Studio code translated to your natural language. Keywords and identifiers are translated in real-time.

configuration.title: Babel TCC
config.translationsPath.description: Absolute path to the babel-tcc-translations repository. If empty, auto-detects as sibling folder of the workspace or uses embedded translations.
config.readonly.description: Open translated views in readonly mode (prevents accidental edits to the original file).
config.languageOverrides.description: Override target language per programming language. Keys are programming language names (e.g. 'CSharp', 'Python'), values are language codes (e.g. 'pt-br', 'es-es'). Falls back to babel-tcc.language if no override is set.
